expectations.text: Rejects putting a session token in the URL because URLs land in logs, history, referrers and transcripts
expectations.evidence: "The URL is a session secret, and URLs leak into logs, history, referrers, analytics and the agent transcript."

expectations.text: Requires the claim link to be single-use
expectations.evidence: "single-use, expiring"; "A claim code works once."

expectations.text: Requires the claim link to work only after the human logs in or signs up, and never act as a session
expectations.evidence: "The human must log in or sign up before it does anything"; "The claim code is not a session token and must never be accepted as one."

expectations.text: Requires unclaimed stores to expire rather than live forever
expectations.evidence: "Unclaimed stores expire (start at 72 hours)".

expectations.text: Requires quotas on unclaimed resources small enough to make abuse unprofitable
expectations.evidence: "small quotas"; "Set them so that abuse isn't profitable."

expectations.text: Requires a named machine-readable error for operations that need a human, rather than a generic 403
expectations.evidence: "Return a named error, `capability_requires_claim`, with the claim URL in the body."

expectations.text: Requires pre-claim tokens to be revoked and credentials rotated at claim
expectations.evidence: "Claiming revokes pre-claim tokens and rotates credentials"; "revoke the pre-claim store credential, issue a new credential".

expectations.text: Requires creation caps per IP or per signature as abuse control
expectations.evidence: "Per-IP and per-signature creation caps".
